summary: Tested QuantDesk algo trading MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass including auth, broker keys, market data, strategies CRUD, backtest, orders/positions, portfolio, and AI chat (Claude via Emergent LLM key). Frontend: login, dashboard, strategies, python editor (backtest renders), visual builder, orders flow all work. Critical issue found: /api-keys frontend route collides with Kubernetes ingress (which routes any path starting with /api to backend) — page returns backend 404 JSON instead of React UI.

minor.issue: Dead code path in ai_chat: prior history loop has a break after the first user message, never actually replays history. Conversation context relies solely on emergentintegrations session_id continuity. Not a failure, but misleading.

ui_bugs.issue: Route path '/api-keys' starts with '/api' which Kubernetes ingress routes to backend (port 8001). Visiting /api-keys returns {"detail":"Not Found"} JSON from FastAPI instead of the React page. The API Keys page is effectively unreachable in the deployed preview.
React hydration error: <span> rendered inside <option> element (Orders.jsx line ~74). Causes console error and possible hydration mismatch.
Recharts warning: width(-1) height(-1) - ResponsiveContainer parent has 0/undefined dimensions on initial render.
data-testid='logout-btn' not present in DOM (test selector returned null). Logout button may use a different testid or be inside a dropdown not opened by default.
Send button testid mismatch. Found [data-testid='ai-input'] but neither 'ai-send-btn' nor 'chat-send' present. Could not exercise the send flow via UI (backend AI chat verified separately and works).
Could not verify form testids (api-key-input/api-secret-input/save-broker-keys-btn) because route is unreachable (see CRITICAL). Even if selectors exist, the page never renders.

Verify data-testid='logout-btn' is present and visible in Layout.jsx top bar (test could not find it).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py exec()s user Python code in a sandbox with only restricted builtins, but no import restriction or timeout. A user could write infinite loops or memory abuse via list multiplication. Add resource/time limit (e.g., signal-based timeout or subprocess) before exposing to untrusted users.
JWT_SECRET is set in .env (good), but ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES=7 days is long without refresh-token rotation; acceptable for MVP.
/api/orders accepts any qty including negative/zero — add pydantic validators (qty > 0).
Routing collision: any frontend path starting with /api will be eaten by the ingress. Document this and avoid such paths.

rca of the issue: Kubernetes ingress is configured to route any URL path matching /api* to backend port 8001 (FastAPI). The frontend React route '/api-keys' matches this prefix, so the request never reaches the React SPA — instead FastAPI receives GET /api-keys, finds no matching route, and returns 404 JSON. Reproduction: open https://bottrader-pro-4.preview.emergentagent.com/api-keys → shows {"detail":"Not Found"}. Mitigation: rename route to /broker-keys (or /keys, /credentials) in App.js Router config AND in Layout.jsx sidebar link AND wherever navigate('/api-keys') is called.
